referenceSources.title: Coche del día: Lancia Delta HPE 2.0 HF (836) - espíritu RACER
referenceSources.description:
A vibrant yellow Lancia Delta HPE 2.0 HF from the second generation (836) glides down a road, its sporty three‑door silhouette accentuated by a large front spoiler, widened wheel arches, and a rear wing. The HF badge on the grille and the bold “LANCIA HPE” plate emphasize its high‑performance pedigree.

Under the hood lies a 1,995 cm³ four‑cylinder turbocharged engine producing 186 CV (upgraded to 193 CV in 1997), paired with a five‑speed manual gearbox and a viscous limited‑slip differential. Inside, Recaro seats, a comprehensive instrument cluster, and features like climate control and fog lights underscore its blend of comfort and competition. With a top speed of 218 km/h and 0–100 km/h in 7.6 seconds, this compact executive hatchback delivers both Italian style and racing‑inspired performance.
